title: Crestline Fleet Account Tire Care Points from Documented Rotations
content:
A business that keeps its tires rotated at Crestline stores earns tire care points on the early-pay discount of its Crestline Fleet Account. Tire care points are added to the early-pay rate, the percent at which the early-pay discount is figured on an invoice that earns it.

## Points

| Tire rotations performed on the business's vehicles at Crestline stores less than twelve whole months before today | Tire care points |
|---|---|
| six or more | 0.25 |
| three to five | 0.10 |
| fewer than three | none |

The rotations are read from the Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty records of the business: each rotation entry documented on a work order for one of its tire sets, counted by the work order date, within the last twelve whole months.

## Boundaries

- 2 rotations earn none; 3 earn 0.10.
- 5 rotations earn 0.10; 6 earn 0.25.

## Strength of the points

The points are percentage points of the early-pay rate: 0.25 points on a hypothetical early-pay rate of 2 percent make it 2.25 percent. On a program whose early-pay discount percent is 0, the invoice earns no discount, whatever is added to the early-pay rate.
